profile.about:
I'm Alkesh Kumar, a passionate Full Stack Developer who loves transforming creative ideas into modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications.

I work with technologies like React, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and MySQL to build complete web solutions, from intuitive frontend interfaces to powerful backend systems.

I enjoy solving real-world problems, learning emerging technologies, and developing projects that combine functionality, performance, and great design.

My goal is to continuously grow as a software developer and create impactful digital products that make a difference.

highlights.text: Building modern, responsive and interactive user interfaces using React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

highlights.title: Backend Development
highlights.text: Developing secure REST APIs, server-side applications and efficient database integrations using Java, Spring Boot and Node.js.

highlights.title: Full Stack Solutions
highlights.text: Creating complete end-to-end web applications with clean architecture, optimized performance and scalable technologies.

highlights.title: Problem Solving
highlights.text: Turning complex challenges into practical solutions through logical thinking, creativity and continuous learning.

projects.title: AI Career Recommendation System
projects.description: An intelligent career guidance platform that recommends suitable career paths based on users' skills, interests and preferences using machine learning.

projects.title: FindIt – Lost & Found Platform
projects.description: A full-stack platform that helps users report lost and found items, submit claims, communicate securely and reconnect belongings with their rightful owners.

projects.title: Convertly – Online File Converter
projects.description: A web-based conversion tool that allows users to convert documents and files between formats, including PDF, Word, Excel and images, through a simple and user-friendly interface.

projects.title: ChatGPT & Claude for Beginners – AI eBook
projects.description: Created a comprehensive beginner-friendly eBook that teaches readers how to use ChatGPT and Claude effectively. It covers AI tools, practical prompting techniques, real-world use cases, productivity tips and hands-on examples. Also developed a dedicated website to showcase and sell the eBook online.
